Transformation Logic: Validated against pattern STU-XXXXXX; rejected if it does not match exactly
Validated as a well formed email address; no transformation applied
Trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace; length checked between 2 and 120 characters
Parsed using the exact format Year-Month-Day; rejected if format does not match
Free text description is deconstructed into a strict True or False value based on presence of a formal diagnosis; the original free text is not stored
Coerced from incoming Yes or No style string into a strict Boolean; rejected if any other value such as Maybe is received
Must equal True or the record is rejected outright before staging
Deconstructed from an enrollment status string into a strict Boolean indicating whether the student was previously enrolled
Free text schedule notes are deconstructed into exactly one of four Allowed Values: Daily, Weekly, As Needed, or Not Applicable
Recorded automatically at the time of successful validation, not taken from the raw payload
